Social Media Viral Spread Analyzer

Problem Statement

A social media platform contains N users connected by directed follower relationships.

When a user shares a post:
The post spreads level by level (BFS traversal).
Every minute, it spreads to direct followers of the current level.
A user receives the post only once.

Your task is to analyze viral spread for a given starting user.

You must calculate:
1. Total Reach → Total number of users who receive the post
2. Time to Go Viral → Number of minutes required to reach all possible users
3. Most Influential User → The user who can reach the maximum number of users if they start the post

Input Format
First line:
n m

Next m lines:
u v (user u follows user v → directed edge u → v)

Last line:
startUser

Output Format
Print in a single line:

TotalReach TimeToViral MostInfluentialUser
